data.description: A Chinese man in his late 30s standing alone in a modern office building corridor in China, staring at a red court seal notice taped across an office door. The seal is bright red with official Chinese characters. The door is slightly ajar with the paper edge curling up from air conditioning draft. Fluorescent corridor lights are cold and harsh. The man looks exhausted and defeated, wearing an old business shirt with slightly yellowed collar. Empty hallway, no other people visible. Realistic photography style, cinematic composition, shallow depth of field focusing on the red seal on door, moody atmosphere.
